{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Junker Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of 4 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] used by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighters, along with [[Logan Squadron]] and [[Yme Squadron]] attempted to protect [[Muurian transport]]s ''[[Botani]]'', and an [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttle]] ''[[Com 1]]'' from being captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]]. The fighters were all destroyed by [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]], one of which piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and the transports were captured.
